requirements.statement: A risk scenario may name a product, facility or supply dependency; a facility-only scenario must not require inventing a product.
requirements.boundary: Facility-only and dependency-only contexts are admitted.
requirements.negative: Missing all three contexts is rejected.

requirements.statement: A report carrier may encode explicit reported claims. Multiple carriers may refer to one explicitly identified claim; a stable case identifier must not equate updated claims or carriers.
requirements.positive: Two distinct carriers explicitly reference one claim.
requirements.boundary: Same case identifier with changed claim retains distinct identities.
requirements.negative: Missing or untyped claim and carrier-as-claim are rejected.

requirements.statement: An attributed signal assessment names the assessing organization, independently of jurisdiction and without implying regulator status.
requirements.positive: Result, assessment, time, status and organization are retrievable.
requirements.boundary: Two assessments can have distinct assessing organizations.
requirements.negative: Missing or untyped assessing organization is rejected.

requirements.statement: A pharmaceutical service profile has a product or facility context and a capability; the specification alone does not entail execution.
requirements.positive: Product-grounded service with capability is admitted.
requirements.boundary: Facility-grounded service without an executed activity is admitted.
requirements.negative: Generic service with no pharmaceutical context is rejected.

requirements.statement: A documented partnership references a commitment assertion about its participant organizations, supported through existing EvidenceSupport and source-record roles.
requirements.positive: Agreement, commitment, participants and source are traceable.
requirements.boundary: Casual contact without an agreement does not entail PartnerOrganizationRole.
requirements.negative: Missing commitment, missing evidence or a commitment actor outside the agreement is rejected.

requirements.statement: Within a manufacturing-use profile, a transformation supports a real ManufacturingActivity with named product and facility; digital-service and deployment component references must agree.
requirements.positive: Transformation, manufacturing event, product and facility are retrievable.
requirements.boundary: One manufacturing event can use separate transformations/deployments.
requirements.negative: Missing manufacturing context, product or inconsistent service component is rejected.

requirements.statement: The organization responsible for a transformation is explicit and may differ from the deployment organization.
requirements.positive: Responsible organization and deployment organization are separately retrievable.
requirements.boundary: Different responsible and deployment organizations are permitted.
requirements.negative: Missing responsibility cannot be filled from deployment organization alone.

requirements.statement: Within the surveillance admission profile, the activity identifies its source records and applicable recorded requirement; source citation does not itself establish compliance or causality.
requirements.positive: Surveillance source and requirement are retrievable.
requirements.boundary: A non-case study source is allowed.
requirements.negative: Missing or untyped surveillance source is rejected.

E2B.supports: Case identifiers persist across some retransmissions/follow-up; not an ontology identity key for content.
E2B.does_not_establish: Complete ICSR schema conformance or whole-report content identity.

GVP-IX.supports: Sources, signal assessment and documented outcomes are distinguished.
GVP-IX.does_not_establish: Universal jurisdiction applicability or the proposed OntoUML mapping.

PROV-O.locator: 3.1, especially agent responsibility and activity association
PROV-O.supports: Activity responsibility may be recorded explicitly.
PROV-O.does_not_establish: That software deployment organization is the responsible agent for every transformation.

ONTOUML-MEDIATION.supports: Relator mediation must not be assigned merely because a relation has an organizational endpoint.

limits: These are eight scoped refinements of the original 24 requirements, not eight independent author-approved requirements.
A report claim is not a complete ICSR/report content object.
No automatic owl:sameAs by case identifier, text similarity or carrier linkage.
Manufacturing is a deliberately bounded first business-activity interface, not every pharmaceutical activity.
Evidence presence is not independent verification of commitment or a legal compliance verdict.
